customManagers.description: Pin <role>_image_version/_image_tag next to the image name in role defaults
Pin images whose tag is written into the name (heimdall, minecraft-bedrock-server)

packageRules.description: Name the role(s) an image bump touches in the title, e.g. 'firefly - Update mariadb Docker tag to v10.11', and list them in the PR body when a shared dependency lands in one branch. `upgrades` is the only place the full role list exists
Date-tagged images parse as a bare year under docker versioning

One PR for the website deps, titled 'website - ...', pinned like Docusaurus already is; caret ranges there only ever produced lockfile-only PRs. The group topic override avoids 'website - Update website dependencies'
Major upgrades are proposed but need approval on the dependency dashboard
Pinned in four places (pyproject, pre-commit, ci.yml, integration.yml); Renovate only sees pyproject, so bumps must be manual
Runtime versions are a CI decision, and .python-version already disagrees with the workflows
